name: Metro Mall
summary: Metro Mall is a community shopping center in Queens, NY, serving the Middle Village neighborhood with convenient retail and services. Operating daily from 9 AM to 10 PM, it provides local residents with accessible everyday shopping options.
demographics: Metro Mall serves a diverse, working-class to middle-income population in the Middle Village neighborhood of Queens. The primary trade area consists of multi-generational households with a mix of long-time residents and newer immigrant families, particularly from Asian and Hispanic communities. Shoppers tend to be value-conscious, seeking convenient access to everyday goods and services within their neighborhood. The center attracts local residents looking for practical shopping options rather than luxury or entertainment-focused retail experiences.
description: Metro Mall is a neighborhood shopping destination located at 65-03 Metropolitan Avenue in the heart of Queens, New York. Serving the diverse Middle Village community and surrounding neighborhoods, this center has established itself as a convenient local hub for everyday shopping needs. With its accessible location along Metropolitan Avenue, Metro Mall provides residents with easy access to a variety of retail and service options. The center maintains extended operating hours from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, accommodating the busy schedules of working families and local shoppers. With a solid 4.2-star rating from nearly 4,800 reviews, Metro Mall has built a reputation as a reliable community shopping center that serves the practical needs of Queens residents.
